verdict.rationale: Replica-skill runs as AI skills inside Claude Code and produces suggestions from the user's own project. It compares your clone against the original and reports a parity score with what is missing (gh-7). It logs bugs by severity from a generated test plan (gh-6), and it checks your store listing for problems (gh-15). It also mines real app reviews into fixes and a positioning angle (gh-10), and entrepreneur mode tells you whether a clone is worth building (gh-11). These insights are tied to the clone-building workflow rather than general analysis of arbitrary user data, and some checks are deterministic scripts rather than AI reasoning. Missing for 10: general-purpose insights over arbitrary user or business data, documented depth or examples of the insight output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
